notes.title: Present and Future Games!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/6842143/55240b6ef1b11e910143200665ed077b7b51f1f5.jpg[/img]

First things first, two new affiliated games to wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3317600/A_Tale_of_Brothers/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3317620/Clan_Duramont/

And don't forget Indinera's quirky and unique game [i]Sylia[/i] is still on sale for a few more day. As it's the entire game (Act 1 + Act 2) that is available right now, as featured on the Aldorlea website, at $6.99 with its 50 hours of playtime, it's an absolute catch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/370630/Sylia/?curator_clanid=6842143

Remember in May you're getting two games from [b]Aldorlea[/b], [i]Odessa[/i] and [i]Night of the Stars[/i]!

[i]Odessa[/i] features a mysterious and suspenseful story with great dialogues whereas [i]Night of the Stars[/i] is more focused on gameplay with its dungeons to explore and many spells to use and even level up to discover new, more powerful ones.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3318360/Odessa/?curator_clanid=6842143

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1694860/Night_of_the_Stars/?curator_clanid=6842143
